typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ExportDate as timestamp (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFileNoMarket as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	ExportFullFile as string (),
	Market as string (),
	MarketName as string (),
	MarketNames as string (),
	ReportDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		CM_CASE_TYPE as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT as string,
		CASE_ID as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string,
		CASE_CREATION_DATE as date,
		MEMBER_DOB as timestamp,
		Health_Plan_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT CASE_ID 	,AGENT 	,MEMBER_NAME 	,MEMBER_DOB 	,CASE_CREATION_DATE 	,CM_CASE_TYPE 	,Health_Plan_name 	,DISPOSITIONCODE 	,DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION FROM [dbo].[PDS_CM_ENROLLMENT_CALL_ATTEMPTS]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		CM_CASE_TYPE as string,
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		AGENT_ID as string,
		CASE_ID as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION as string,
		DISPOSITIONCODE as string,
		CASE_CREATION_DATE as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MEMBER_DOB as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Health_Plan_name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CM_CASE_TYPE,
		MEMBER_NAME,
		AGENT_ID = AGENT,
		CASE_ID,
		DISPOSITIONCODE_DESCRIPTION,
		DISPOSITIONCODE,
		CASE_CREATION_DATE,
		MEMBER_DOB,
		Health_Plan_name)) ~> FlatFileDestination
